name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €91/MWh on 13 Nov, up 10% on the week and above the €70 Alert line; Hormuz LNG route restricted
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €91/MWh on 13 Nov, 10.3% higher on the week, 43% higher over three months and 12.5% below its 52-week high of €104, well above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Qatari LNG relies on the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran said an LNG carrier hit a mine on 13 Nov and UKMTO put traffic about 65% below pre-conflict levels in the week to 10 Nov (CBS News; Gulf News).
for_you: High wholesale gas prices tend to feed into household energy bills through the Ofgem price cap with a lag, and into costs for energy-intensive industry.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF natural gas futures (TTF=F)
Gulf News — Hormuz shipping 'below normal, but not stalled': UKMTO

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
